newsitem.title: USA: Allen Telecom completes FOREM acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Allen Telecom completes FOREM acquisition.

text.p: Allen Telecom Inc said on Wednesday that it had acquired the outstanding minority interest in FOREM SpA to achieve full ownership of the company.
In a series of transactions, Allen Telecom paid $21.7 million in cash and $5 million in Allen Telecom common stock to the minority shareholders of FOREM, Allen Telecom said in a statement.
Allen Telecom acquired an initial 40 percent interest in FOREM in December 1994 and an additional 40 percent in March 1995.
The total purchase price for the minority interest will be computed after the net income for FOREM's 1997 fiscal year is finalized, the company said.
The acquisition also increases Allen Telecom's ownership of FOREM's 62-percent-owned subsidiary MIKOM GmbH.
FOREM manufactures filters, combiners and tower mount amplifiers for GSM cellular and DCS 1800 wireless communications systems. Its MIKOM subsidiary makes GSM and DCS 1800 repeaters.
Allen Telecom Inc supplies systems expansion products to the two-way wireless communications market.
